content_hash: sha512: the hash used for the exclusions and the deduplication

adversary_starts.generator: torch.Generator('cpu').manual_seed(seed); torch.rand(shape, generator, dtype=float32) per module in order

routing.use: a torch.Generator seeded with seed_from_tuple(key), passed as `generator` to the authors' samplers

pool_notes.A9_to_A16_and_H9_to_H16: unused unless the freeze file enlarges question 2's design to 16 x 16
pool_notes.DOM: drawn from the rows left on each side after R (attack) and H16 (held-out); code: 128 Github rows; prose: 64 Pile-CC and 64 Wikipedia (en) rows; mixed rows excluded
pool_notes.sides: WS, Q, Q1, and DU have no side; their rows and documents are excluded from every sided pool

DU.note: the first post's donors D_unif, rows 1,024 to 2,047, as they are; used only by G4's reproduction of D_unif_main. Its rows and their documents are excluded from every other pool

Q.note: the first post's recipients, rows 0 to 1,023, as they are

WS_W16.note: the authors' loader at world size 16, rank order

WS_W32.note: the authors' loader at world size 32, rank order

WS_W8.note: the authors' loader at world size 8, rank order

seed_function: vpd_audit.masks.seed_from_tuple @ b6d3bac: SHA-256 of repr(tuple), first 8 bytes little-endian, masked to 63 bits; key (master, purpose, ...)
text_hashes: sha256_513: SHA-256 of the row's 513 int32 ids; sha256_512: of the first 512, the ids the model sees
text_id: v<position>: the row's position in stream order (files in name order, rows in file order), as the earlier harness reads it
tokenization_batches: 1,120 batches: 160 shards of 6,250 documents, each six batches of 1,000 and one of 250 (data/doc_recovery/recovery.json)
